مِدَكٌ (tropical:) A strong man, that treads the ground vehemently: (S, TA:) or strong to work; (K;) and the fem., with ة, is applied in this latter sense to a female slave. (S, K.) ＝
-A2- Also a dial. var. [now vulgarly used] of مِتَكٌّ [q. v.]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
